WorkspaceNote.title: WorkspaceNote
WorkspaceNote.description: A private note stored in the user's cloud-synced workspace.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated note owner.

title.description: Title of the note (1 to 120 characters).

content.description: Body content of the note (up to 10,000 characters).

isPinned.description: Whether the note is pinned to the top of the workspace.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the note was created (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the note was last updated (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

VaultItem.title: VaultItem
VaultItem.description: A private vault record tracking imported local media or secure secrets.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated vault owner.

title.description: Display label for the vault item (1 to 120 characters).

secretNote.description: Optional secret text or caption associated with the item (up to 5,000 characters).

localFileName.description: Internal private_media file name if stored on device (0 to 255 characters).

mimeType.description: MIME type of the vault asset (1 to 100 characters).

sizeBytes.description: Size of the item in bytes.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the vault item was created (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the vault item was last updated (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/vault_items/{itemId}.description: User-scoped private vault records and media metadata.
